To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The user interface for ambient intelligent environments should be based on the user’s perception of the world and his or her ability to interact with that world; (2) The user interface should be based on a user model that is derived from a user’s behavior and that includes the user’s perception, cognition, and action capabilities; (3) The user interface is a dynamic system that is continuously adapting itself to the user’s needs; (4) The user interface must provide a natural and

• the design of user interfaces for Ambient Intelligence and smart environments is not a matter of designing a new user interface for a new application, but a matter of designing new interfaces for the old user, • this new user is the user as he/she has been for a long time, and the new interface is the interface as it has been for a longtime, but the context is new and the interaction is different, • the new context is characterized by the fact that the user is in a new situation
• The use of the term "user interface" is not consistent in the literature and the term should be used with care.

the following questions: - What are the input devices and how do we use them?
the design and evaluation of novel user interfaces for ambient intelligent environments, with a focus on smart spaces.
how the human interacts with smart environments and how the human is supported in this interaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are many ways and many possibilities to create smart environments.
the field of Ambient Intelligence is not only about the smartness of the underlying technology, but also about the smartness in the interaction with the human user.
the user interfaces and the Human-Computer Interaction for Ambient Intelligence and smart environments are still in the early stages of development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a new approach to the problem of user interface design for smart environments, which allows to create user interfaces for smart environments in a way that is similar to creating user interfaces for traditional applications.
the user interfaces and the Human-Computer-Interaction (HCI) in Ambient Intelligence and Smart environments is not yet well understood.
we try to understand the human as the central component in a smart environment and to create a user interface that enables the human to interact with the smart environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the user interface of a smart environment is not just a set of devices and their interaction vocabulary.
the user interface and interaction design for Ambient Intelligence and smart environments is a complex task.
we need to develop a much more comprehensive understanding of the interaction vocabulary that can be enabled by the devices we have available and that we can develop or acquire in the future.
